title: Workplace Culture and the Measurement of Outcomes
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。请先听/读对话，完成10道听力题；再学习语法规则并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案均来自原文，注意定位关键词。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, Tom. You look worried. What's going on?
Tom: It's the new performance system. My manager, Rachel, wants us to log every task we do. She says it will help us measure outcomes better.
Maya: That sounds reasonable. What's the problem?
Tom: The problem is that we spend more time logging than working. Yesterday I spent forty minutes filling in a form about a ten-minute phone call.
Maya: Oh, I see. So the measurement itself is slowing you down.
Tom: Exactly. And because we're all busy logging, we've stopped helping each other. Last week, I didn't help a new colleague because I was behind on my log.
Maya: That's a real cost. But if you don't measure anything, how do you know what's working?
Tom: I agree we need some measurement. But the current system only counts quantity, not quality. For example, it counts how many calls we make, not how well we solve problems.
Maya: So the numbers don't show the full picture.
Tom: Right. And there's another issue. The system compares teams, so people hide problems to look good. If a team admits a mistake, they get a lower score.
Maya: That's dangerous. It encourages people to hide errors instead of fixing them.
Tom: Yes. And the worst part is that Rachel doesn't see this. She only looks at the dashboard.
Maya: Have you talked to her about it?
Tom: I tried. But she said the system is fair because everyone is measured the same way.
Maya: Hmm. That's a common argument, but it's not quite right. Measuring everyone the same way doesn't mean the measurement is fair if the work is different. For instance, if one team handles complex cases and another handles simple ones, the same metrics can't capture that difference fairly. Fairness in measurement depends on whether the metrics reflect the actual demands of the job.
Tom: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of it that way.
Maya: What if you suggested a small change? For instance, add a quality check to the system, or ask for a monthly team discussion about what the numbers miss.
Tom: That could work. But I'm not sure Rachel will listen. She's under pressure from senior management.
Maya: Maybe you could frame it as a way to improve the system, not as a criticism. If you show her that the current system hides problems, she might be more open.
Tom: So instead of saying "the system is bad," I could say "here's how to make it better."
Maya: Exactly. And you could bring examples from your team. Real stories are more convincing than opinions.
Tom: OK. I'll prepare a short document with two or three examples. But what if she still says no?
Maya: Then at least you've raised the issue. And you could ask for a trial period for the new idea. A trial is less threatening than a permanent change.
Tom: That makes sense. I feel better already. Thanks, Maya.
Maya: No problem. Let me know how it goes.

grammar.title: 因果关系、条件和对比；段落间逻辑与指代
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 因果：because, so, that's why 等连接原因和结果；2) 条件：if 引导条件句，主句用情态动词或将来时；3) 对比：but, however, instead of, rather than 表示转折或替代；4) 段落间逻辑与指代：用 this, that, these, those, it, they 指代前文内容，使段落连贯。注意：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will/might/can 等。
grammar.example: If a team admits a mistake, they get a lower score.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The team was late, ______ the manager was angry.
questions.explanation: 前后为因果关系，前因后果用 so。
questions.evidence: The team was late, so the manager was angry.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ you finish the report, we can go home.
questions.explanation: 表示条件，用 If 引导条件从句。
questions.evidence: If you finish the report, we can go home.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She didn't call me, ______ she sent an email.
questions.explanation: 前后为转折对比关系，用 but。
questions.evidence: She didn't call me, but she sent an email.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We use a checklist ______ of a long report.
questions.explanation: instead of 表示替代，用 instead。
questions.evidence: We use a checklist instead of a long report.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: The system is slow. ______ is why we are late.
questions.explanation: 指代前文整个情况，用 That。
questions.evidence: The system is slow. That is why we are late.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ it rains, the event will be inside.
questions.evidence: If it rains, the event will be inside.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: He was tired, ______ he finished the work.
questions.evidence: He was tired, but he finished the work.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: The forms are long. ______ take too much time.
questions.evidence: The forms are long. They take too much time.
